import { getBackendEquipmentDecomposeQuery } from '@src/api/bot/equipment-batch-decompose';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 一键分解装备指令处理器
 * 指令格式:
 *   /一键分解装备            → 展示品级选择面板
 *   /一键分解装备 全部        → 预览待分解内容，需确认
 *   /一键分解装备 <品级名>    → 预览待分解内容，需确认
 */
import App, { fetchGradeOptionsApp, previewApp } from '@src/response-apps/equipment/batchDecompose/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import type { GuiButton } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse, useSubscribe } from 'alemonjs';

const COMMAND_KEYWORD = '一键分解装备';

/** 确认超时时间（毫秒） */
const CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS = 60 * 1000;

/** 分解明细最大展示条数 */
const MAX_DETAIL_DISPLAY = 20;

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [subscribe] = useSubscribe(selects);
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const rawText = String(e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
    const argPart = rawText.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?一键分解装备\s*/, '').trim();

    /** 获取品级选项（所有分支都需要） */
    const query = await getBackendEquipmentDecomposeQuery(bid, uid, argPart);
    const optionsResult = await fetchGradeOptionsApp(bid, uid, query.options);

    if (optionsResult.code !== 'OK') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(optionsResult.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const { totalCount, grades: sortedGrades } = optionsResult.data;

    // 无可分解装备时提示
    if (totalCount === 0) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('暂无可分解的装备');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('💡 可分解的装备需满足：未装备、未锁定');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    /** 构建品级映射：品级名 → { id, name } */
    const gradeMap = new Map<string, { id: number; name: string }>();

    gradeMap.set('全部', { id: 0, name: '全部品级' });
    for (const g of sortedGrades) {
      gradeMap.set(g.name, { id: g.id, name: g.name });
    }

    // 无参数 → 展示品级选择面板
    if (!argPart) {
      const footerRows: GuiButton[][] = [];

      footerRows.push([{ label: `全部 (${totalCount}件)`, command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD} 全部` }]);
      for (let i = 0; i < sortedGrades.length; i += 3) {
        const slice = sortedGrades.slice(i, i + 3);

        footerRows.push(slice.map(g => ({ label: `${g.name} (${g.count}件)`, command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD} ${g.name}` })));
      }

      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addBold(COMMAND_KEYWORD);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('选择分解范围，每次最多分解300件。');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('💡 已装备、已锁定的装备不会被分解');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: footerRows }));

      return;
    }

    /** 在 gradeMap 中查找匹配的品级 */
    const selectedGrade = gradeMap.get(argPart);

    if (!selectedGrade) {
      const footerRows: GuiButton[][] = [];

      footerRows.push([{ label: `全部 (${totalCount}件)`, command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD} 全部` }]);
      for (let i = 0; i < sortedGrades.length; i += 3) {
        const slice = sortedGrades.slice(i, i + 3);

        footerRows.push(slice.map(g => ({ label: `${g.name} (${g.count}件)`, command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD} ${g.name}` })));
      }

      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`❌ 无效的品级：${argPart}`);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('请从下方按钮选择品级：');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: footerRows }));

      return;
    }

    const gradeId = selectedGrade.id === 0 ? undefined : selectedGrade.id;

    // ===== 二次确认：先预览 =====
    if (!query.preview) {
      throw new Error('一键分解预览接口响应不完整');
    }
    const previewResult = await previewApp({ bid, uid, gradeId, prepared: query.preview });

    if (previewResult.code !== 'OK') {
      const failMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      failMd.addText('❌ 预览失败');
      failMd.addNewline();
      failMd.addNewline();
      failMd.addText(previewResult.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: failMd, footer: [{ label: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD}`, command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD}` }] }));

      return;
    }

    /** 构建预览信息 */
    const previewMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    previewMd.addBold('⚠️ 分解确认');
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText(`分解范围：${selectedGrade.name}`);
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText(`待分解总数：${previewResult.data.totalCount} 件`);
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText(`本次分解：${previewResult.data.processCount} 件；剩余：${previewResult.data.remainingCount} 件`);
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addBold('范围内品级分布：');
    previewMd.addNewline();

    for (const gb of previewResult.data.gradeBreakdown) {
      previewMd.addText(`• ${gb.gradeName} ×${gb.count}`);
      previewMd.addNewline();
    }

    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText(`📦 预估获得 矿石精华 ×${previewResult.data.totalYield}`);
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText('请在60秒内回复【确认分解】或【取消】');

    const confirmFooter: GuiButton[] = [
      { label: '确认分解', command: '确认分解' },
      { label: '取消', command: '取消' }
    ];

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: previewMd, footer: [confirmFooter] }));

    // 进入订阅等待确认
    const sub = subscribe.mount(
      async (event, next) => {
        const [msg] = useMessage();
        const choice = event.MessageText.trim();

        if (choice === '确认分解') {
          clearTimeout(timeout);

          const result = await App({ bid, uid, gradeId, request: createBackendRequestContext(event) });

          if (result.code !== 'OK') {
            const failMd = Format.createMarkdown();

            failMd.addText('❌ 分解失败');
            failMd.addNewline();
            failMd.addNewline();
            failMd.addText(result.data.message);

            void msg.send(
              FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: failMd, footer: [{ label: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD}`, command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD}` }] })
            );

            return;
          }

          /** 构建分解成功信息 */
          const okMd = Format.createMarkdown();

          okMd.addBold('✅ 分解成功');
          okMd.addNewline();
          okMd.addText(`分解范围：${selectedGrade.name}`);
          okMd.addNewline().addText(`分解数量：${result.data.decomposedCount} 件`);
          if (result.data.remainingCount > 0) {
            okMd.addNewline().addText(`数量过多，本次已分解${result.data.decomposedCount}件，剩余${result.data.remainingCount}件可分解。`);
          }
          okMd.addNewline();
          okMd.addNewline();

          const showDetails = result.data.details.slice(0, MAX_DETAIL_DISPLAY);

          okMd.addBold('分解明细');
          okMd.addNewline();

          for (const detail of showDetails) {
            okMd.addText(`• ${detail.name}(${detail.grade}) → 矿石精华 ×${detail.yield}`);
            okMd.addNewline();
          }

          if (result.data.details.length > MAX_DETAIL_DISPLAY) {
            okMd.addText(`...等共 ${result.data.details.length} 件装备`);
            okMd.addNewline();
          }

          okMd.addNewline();
          okMd.addText(`📦 共获得 矿石精华 ×${result.data.totalYield}`);
          okMd.addNewline();

          const okFooter = [
            { label: '继续分解', command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD} ${argPart}` },
            { label: '查看储物袋', command: '/我的储物袋 装备' }
          ];

          void msg.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: okMd, footer: okFooter }));

          return;
        }

        if (choice === '取消') {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
          const cancelMd = Format.createMarkdown();

          cancelMd.addText('已取消分解操作');
          cancelMd.addNewline();
          cancelMd.addText('💡 可以先锁定不想分解的装备，再使用一键分解');

          void msg.send(
            FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: cancelMd, footer: [{ label: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD}`, command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD}` }] })
          );

          return;
        }

        /** 提示回复确认或取消 */
        const hintMd = Format.createMarkdown();
        const hintFooter = [
          { label: '确认分解', command: '确认分解' },
          { label: '取消', command: '取消' }
        ];

        hintMd.addText('请回复【确认分解】或【取消】');

        void msg.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: hintMd, footer: [hintFooter] }));

        next();
      },
      ['UserId']
    );

    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        subscribe.cancel(sub);
        const timeoutMd = Format.createMarkdown();

        timeoutMd.addText('⏰ 确认超时，分解操作已自动取消');

        void message.send(
          FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: timeoutMd, footer: [{ label: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD}`, command: `/${COMMAND_KEYWORD}` }] })
        );
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
    }, CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('一键分解装备失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('一键分解装备失败，请稍后再试或联系运营。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});

export default response;
